disqualifier.note: S.is guards for different NativeSelect values (view mode all/tbox/abox vs fold L0-L3). Each onChange feeds a different atom; they are not exclusive-read of one string.
Alternative includesEdge callbacks for different graphs: full-adjacency always-true vs community-artery threshold. Call sites pass one or the other; they are not stored parallel flags on one record.
Independent runner refusals: shapes partition empty vs session signature changed mid-flight. Each writes a different OntologyValidationStatus (blocked vs idle); mixed true/false is legal.
Independent stack emptiness: changeLog and redoStack can each be empty or not, so all four combinations are legal (idle, undo-only, redo-only, both).

Leftover OntologyDocumentRegion pair after the dirty/inferred/undo/redo seed. inferredView is a keep-alive atom; sessionOpen disables the switch without clearing it, so inferred-true with no session is legal.
